text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's so awesome how everyone gets a fire in their eyes whenever it's time to race!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I won't lose the next one! Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, that's true! But in terms of blazing fire, my eyes burned the weakest!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: If our drives were electrical consumption, then they were dishwashers and I… a mere electric toothbrush.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dang it! Why can't I get on their level?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gasp! It must be because their electric networks are series circuits! I need to get in on that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have to use every trick in the book to stop Gold Ship from transforming herself into a series circuit, whatever that entails.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Now let's get me some contacts with LED lights so I can turn my eye-fire up to eleven!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wait, what if I go for ultimate stealth instead? Sneaking up on people and cooking them with eye lasers point-blank sounds cool…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship drags me out to an optometrist, but has no choice but to give up when she's told no such contacts exist.
